acceptance_criteria.summary: Settings exposes Faster Whisper and localEngine persists.
Sidecar protocol carries faster-whisper engine and has a roundtrip test.
Sidecar routes faster-whisper separately from whisper.cpp.
Missing faster-whisper runtime is a controlled error with no whisper.cpp fallback.
Faster-whisper uses the same sidecar lifecycle surface and sidecar cancel kills the Python child.
Docs describe backend selection and requirements.
